profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
Versatile full-stack software engineer with over twenty years of experience in all aspects of software development life cycle. Strong in object-oriented design and integration problem solving skills. 

Results driven individual that has a proven track record meeting software deliverable on time, and without compromising its quality. 

Language Skills: Java/J2EE, .NET/C#, C/C++, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript
Cloud Technologies: Kubernetes, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Amazon AWS Free Tier
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Batch, ASP.NET MVC, Microsoft Web API, Knockout.js, AngularJS, Angular 10, React, Android SDK (Google Play, GCM, Map v2, etc), WPF, WCF, LAMP, jQuery, Spring 3 MVC, Jersey,
Databases: SQLite, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis.
Devop: Azure DevOps, Gitlab CI/CD, Kibana, Grafana
Others: Microservices, Domain-Driven Design, Object-Oriented Design, RESTful Web Service, Web/Desktop/Mobile app programming.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cloud Computing · Java · Technical Leadership · DevOps · Software Design · Spring Boot · Architectural Design · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer/Individual Contributor on the Parts Order Entry Management team.
* Migrated legacy applications (WebLogic/EJB) to Spring Boot/React, hosted on PCF and Kubernetes.
* Responsible for the architecture of POEM REST API.
* Performed DevOps related tasks - Triage live production issues, setup CI/CD pipelines, improve API resiliencies, etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer under the Customer Care and Aftersales organization.
* Migrated legacy applications to Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF).
* Developed multiple batch jobs for performing ETL in Spring Batch.
* Served as DevOp for multiple internal-facing business applications.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer under the Global Sales and Marketing, Customer Experience organization.
* Cloud migration of the ShopClickDrive,com web application into GM data centers.
* Led the Dealer Digital Portal team (4 to 10 engineers). Duties include working with Business and BA to groom stories, mentored junior developers, and performed DevOp tasks.
* Designed and developed a highly scalable CMS for South American dealerships.

positions.title: Sole Proprietor
positions.description:
Published three applications to Android Market:
1. Easy Scorecard - One of the most popular golf/disc golf scoring apps on Android Market. Consistently ranked top 10 in paid 'Sports' category. #1 rated paid Sports app on appbrain.com. Average rating of 4.8. 300,000+ downloads with 30,000 daily users. (Stats as of Jan 2014). http://www.mydroidsoft.com/easyscorecard
2. myTextSpeed - A casual touch-typing speed test with social gaming elements (world ranking, P2P challenge, etc). 200,000+ downloads as of July 2011. [Deprecated]
3. Phonograms - An educational app that helps parent and children practicing Spalding phonograms. Designed for Android tablets in mind. [Deprecated]

positions.title: Lead Android Developer
positions.description:
Working in a scrum team, we designed and implemented the new generation of mobile payment solutions powered by Apriva Wallet. As the lead Android developer, I was responsible for the architecture, design, and the implementation of Apriva Wallet Android app (http://www.apriva.com/products/pos/product/wallet).

Portfolio of Apps:
Dave & Buster's powered by Apriva Wallet: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apriva.mobile.wallet.davebusters

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior developer for the Unified Communicator Advanced (UCA) software, Mitel's flagship Windows application that competes with Microsoft OCS, and Lotus Sametime. Estimated revenue for this product exceeds $10m for the current fiscal year. 

I was the functional lead for the client-side Instant Messaging, Call Processing, Video Conferencing, and the real-time Presence components of UCA. Duties include continuously improving the software by researching for new requirements and features, generating software design document, and the implementation of feature enhancements.

patents.title: Endpoint Status Notification System
patents.description: The endpoint status notification system includes an address book of network user's names and their associated endpoints. A user selects a personal list of contacts from the address book and receives an instant message alert upon every occurrence of a reportable event for one of the contacts on the list. Alerts are informational status messages pertaining to the contact and are delivered unbeknownst to the contact.
